Rule: Each 8-connected non-background object is a 3-cell shape; find its vertex (the cell touching both others, preferring orthogonal joins). From the vertex, sum the two unit arm directions and place a marker 5 cells in the opposite direction; markers are 9, except objects whose rotation-invariant shape class (sorted pairwise squared distances) differs from the majority class emit 1 instead. A marker landing on an object recolors that whole object to the marker color, and 1 overrides 9 when markers coincide (verified: reproduces all three training pairs cell-for-cell, including the (9,7)→1 overlap in pair 1 and the recolored object in pair 3).
